title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.13114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. translated_title: ASPIRE：一个用于迭代推理与探索的智能体化系统辨识平台
translated_abstract: 系统辨识需要在辨识方法的选择、先验物理知识的融入以及模型验证等方面做出专家决策。我们提出了ASPIRE，这是一个用于非线性系统辨识的框架，其中大型语言模型智能体负责选择并执行辨识方法。ASPIRE能够从测量数据中构建闭式（解析形式）的非线性静态或动态模型，并可选择性地辅以系统描述、模型的预期用途，以及以形式化方式或自然语言表达的物理要求。每个模型包含其参数、估计记录、对模型各项的解释，以及在智能体无法访问的测试数据上评估的误差。形式化的物理要求由独立机制进行验证。ASPIRE既可以自主运行，也可以交互式运行，允许智能体提出问题，用户也可以请求进一步的分析和额外的辨识轮次。我们在三个实测系统上对ASPIRE进行了评估：一个移动机器人……（摘要截断）
tldr: ASPIRE是一个由大语言模型智能体驱动的非线性系统辨识框架，能够自主选择并执行辨识方法，从测量数据构建闭式非线性模型，融入先验物理知识并独立验证，且支持自主与交互两种运行模式。
en_tdlr: ASPIRE is an LLM-agent-driven framework for nonlinear system identification that autonomously selects and executes identification methods, constructs closed-form nonlinear models from measured data with incorporated prior physical knowledge, independently verifies formal physical requirements, and operates in both autonomous and interactive modes.
